items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I was working with Johnny Neal's Midnight Ramblers.

ctx.x: was really a joint where the cats used to come from Chicago and dry out, you know. They all liked me there, you know. I was working with Johnny Neal's Midnight Ramblers. So I used to say we should be on the radio. And one night I was singing...
Was that the first time you started to sing, or had you done it before?
